content.comment_body: Hello, I installed [product_name] V6.1 on a PC running Ubuntu 8.04 LTS, and while installation seemed successful, when I launch the application, I only see an empty grey window. The program appears to run but doesn't display any content. For example, using Ctrl-N to create a new file does open the dialog, but afterward there's still just a grey window. Thank you in advance for any help.
I've resolved this issue. To fix this error, you should: 1. Install the latest Java Runtime Environment (JRE) on your system. 2. Remove the JRE directory from your [product_name] installation.

Hi, Another solution is to turn off visual effects in your system settings (see attached screenshots). This workaround should apply for Ubuntu versions 9.04, 8.10, and 8.04. The main cause appears to be the visual effects engine, "compiz."

analysis.insight_summary: Users trying to install [product_name] V6.1 on Ubuntu may encounter an issue where the application window is blank and only displays a grey screen. While keyboard shortcuts and dialogs function, the main interface does not render properly. Solutions include updating Java, removing the bundled JRE, or disabling visual effects (such as Compiz), which points to compatibility challenges between Linux desktop environments and Java applications.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to launch with a working graphical user interface in Linux, allowing for full usability and visibility.
